title: Database Lab (ChatGPT) and the database graph
summary: The Database Lab (packages/oorexx_oodialog_database_lab_v0.1.2, code: ChatGPT; architecture: Tom Dyer) adds a database panel to the designer and the Object Editor (site/database-lab.js, database-lab.css, tools/database.rex, db.* keys in OodUi), in an ooRexx/WASM session of its own. Its Database graph tab (ChatGPT, branch feature/oodialog-database-graph-v2-20261115 at 183d8ac, merged into oodialog-designer as 47c1700 for designer v0.12) draws the open database from OodDatabaseLab~graphLines: TABLE, COLUMN and FK lines from the NoSQLServer catalogue, plus any OBJECT and PART lines in the textarea #dbObjectLines. Tables are boxes (PK, UNIQUE marked), foreign keys arrows with their ON DELETE action, a table of two foreign keys a junction, mapped objects outlines around their tables; a box selects its table. For a bound design the designer fills #dbObjectLines itself when the lab opens (Claude, src/OodBoundGraph.cls: the form's object class mapped over the form's databases in a session of its own with the design's data files); text the user typed there is kept.
invariants: The graph reads graphLines; it does not parse annotations or SQL itself (sphere mapped-objects, article mapped-objects.graph-lines, is the contract).
The Lab makes tables and columns; the mapped-object map only checks against them.
#dbObjectLines is the integration point between the lab (ChatGPT) and the designer (Claude): keep its id.
Open (REQ-00003757): edge labels overlap where edges meet one box, a part label sits under the junction box, an outline's title under another outline.
